([[managing director]]) | num_employees = 136 (2021) | assets = UGX:112.8 billion (2021) | revenue = | industry = [[Financial services]] | products = Loans, savings | website = {{URL|efcug.com}} }} '''EFC Uganda Limited''' ('''EFCUL'''), also known as '''EFC Uganda''', was a microfinance deposit-taking institution (MDI) in [[Uganda]] whose license was withdrawn and liquidated by [[Bank of Uganda]] on 19 January 2024.{{cite web |date=19 January 2024 | url=https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/bou-closes-efc-uganda-limited--4496730 |title=BoU closes EFC Uganda Limited | access-date=19 January 2024 |work=[[Daily Monitor]]}} ==Location== The headquarters of EFCUL were located at Plot 45 Kira Road, on [[Kololo|Kololo Hill]] in the [[Kampala Central Division]], about {{convert|3.5|km|0}} north of the central business district of [[Kampala]], Uganda's capital and largest city.{{google maps| url=https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Uganda+Post+Office,+Plot+35+Kampala+Road,+Kampala+P.O.BOX+7106,+KAMPALA/Riders+Lounge+Ug,+Acacia+Place+%2F+Village+Mall,+Kampala/@0.3284435,32.5886147,14.29z/data=!4m13!4m12!1m5!1m1!1s0x177dbc808cc2ab43:0x7dd3e9e39634c3b!2m2!1d32.58138!2d0.3137559!1m5!1m1!1s0x177dbba698ed86dd:0x4744be4eb77e1567!2m2!1d32.5875132!2d0.3367323?entry=ttu |title=Distance Between Post Office Building, Kampala Road, Kampala, Central Region, Uganda and Riders' Lounge, Kampala, Uganda |access-date=25 June 2024}} The coordinates of the institution's headquarters are 00°20'12.0"N, 32°35'15.0"E (Latitude:0.336667; Longitude:32.587500).{{google maps|title=Location of the Headquarters of EFC Uganda Limited | url=https://www.google.com/maps/place/0%C2%B020'12.0%22N+32%C2%B035'15.0%22E/@0.3366084,32.5853106,17.75z/data=!4m5!3m4!1s0x0:0x0!8m2!3d0.336667!4d32.587 |access-date=12 August 2016}} ==Overview== The institution opened in Uganda in June 2012 as Entrepreneurs Financial Center Limited, with one branch in Ndeeba in the [[Lubaga Division]] of Kampala.{{cite web | url=http://efcug.com/Who-We-Are.html | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160820235644/http://efcug.com/Who-We-Are.html | url-status=usurped | archive-date=August 20, 2016 | title=EFC Uganda: Who We Are | location=Kampala | access-date=12 August 2016 | date=12 August 2016 | publisher=EFC Uganda Limited (EFCUL) | last=EFCUL}} In November 2014, EFCUL was awarded an MDI banking license by the Bank of Uganda, adopting the name EFC Uganda Limited.{{cite web | url=https://www.bou.or.ug/bou/bou-downloads/publications/Annual_Reports/Rpts/All/Annual-Report-2014-2015.pdf | format=PDF | title=Bank of Uganda Annual Report for the Period 1 July 2014 Until 30 June 2015 | publisher=[[Bank of Uganda]] (BOU) | last=BOU | location=Kampala | date=30 June 2015 | access-date=12 August 2016 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160820145947/https://www.bou.or.ug/bou/bou-downloads/publications/Annual_Reports/Rpts/All/Annual-Report-2014-2015.pdf | archive-date=20 August 2016 | url-status=dead }} As of December 2021, EFCUL owned assets of UGX:112.8 billion, with shareholders' equity of UGX:12.982 billion. At that time, the institution employed 136 staff.{{cite web | url=http://efcug.com/MD%27s-Message.html | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161018010154/http://efcug.com/MD%27s-Message.html | url-status=usurped | archive-date=October 18, 2016 | title=Managing Director’s Message | access-date=12 August 2016 | date=31 December 2015 | first=Claude | last=Lafond | location=Kampala}} EFCUL focused on financing micro, medium, and small enterprises.{{cite web | url=http://www.newvision.co.ug/new_vision/news/1427913/efc-uganda-limited |title=EFC Uganda Limited: Advertisement for Three Staff Positions |work=[[New Vision]] |author=EFC Uganda Limited | date=27 June 2016 |access-date=12 August 2016 |location=Kampala, Uganda}} In December 2015, EFCUL received a loan of UGX:10 billion for onward lending to micro, small, and medium-sized businesses.{{cite web |url=http://www.monitor.co.ug/Business/SMEs-to-benefit-from-Shs10b-Dutch-government-loan/688322-2983194-ofpqnmz/index.html |title=SMEs to benefit from Shs10b Dutch government loan |date=4 December 2015 |access-date=12 August 2016 | work=[[Daily Monitor]] |author=Mark Keith Muhumuza | location=Kampala, Uganda}} ==Shareholding== As of August 2016, the shareholding in the stock of the company was as depicted in the table below:{{cite web | url=http://efcug.com/EFC-Investors.html | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160821005142/http://efcug.com/EFC-Investors.html | url-status=usurped | archive-date=August 21, 2016 | title=EFC Uganda Limited: List of Investors | access-date=12 August 2016 | date=12 August 2016 | author=EFCUL | publisher=EFCUL | location=Kampala}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="margin: 0.5em auto" |+ EFC Uganda Limited stock ownership ! Rank !!Name of owner!!Percentage ownership |- | 1 || [[Desjardins Group|Développement international Desjardins]] of [[Canada]] || |- | 2 || [http://www.africinvest.com/ AfricInvest Financial Sector Limited] of [[Mauritius]] || |- | 3 || Uganda Gatsby Trust of Uganda || |- | 4 || [[Belgian Investment Company for Developing Countries|BIO]] of [[Belgium]] || |- | 5 || [http://www.bamboofinance.com/ Bamboo Financial Inclusion Fund] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160812151954/http://www.bamboofinance.com/ |date=2016-08-12 }} of [[Mauritius]] || |- | 6 || [[ASN Bank|ASN-Novib Microcredit Fund]] of the [[Netherlands]] || |- | 7 || EFC Uganda Employee Stock Ownership Fund || |- | 8 || EFC Uganda Customer Stock Ownership Fund || |- | || '''Total''' || '''100.00''' |- |} ==Branches== {{as of|December 2015}}, the institution maintained networked branches at the following locations:{{cite web | url=http://efcug.com/Contact-Us.html | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160821003135/http://efcug.com/Contact-Us.html | url-status=usurped | archive-date=August 21, 2016 | title=EFC Uganda: About Us: Contact Us | access-date=12 August 2015 | date=12 August 2016 | publisher=EFC Uganda Limited (EFCUL) | last=EFCUL | location=Kampala}} # Kololo Branch - Ground Floor, Acacia Place Building, 6 Acacia Avenue, [[Kololo]], [[Kampala]] # Ndeeba Branch - Master Wood Plaza, 1156 [[Kampala-Masaka Road]], [[Ndeeba]], Kampala; main branch # Kireka Branch - 1525 [[Kampala-Jinja Road]], [[Kireka]] # Nansana Branch - [[Kampala-Hoima Road]], [[Nansana]] # Nateete Branch - 1396 Kampala-Masaka Road, [[Nateete]] # Mukono Branch ==Closure and liquidation== On 19 January 2024, the Bank of Uganda revoked the banking license of EFC Uganda Limited, closed the institution and began its liquidation. The reasons stated for the revocation were under-capitalization and failure to adhere to the terms of its banking license.{{cite web| work=Uganda Business News (UBN) | url=https://ugbusiness.com/2024/01/uganda-economy/efc-uganda-closed-by-regulators-bou-takes-control |title=Bank of Uganda shuts down EFC Uganda, takes control |date=19 January 2024 |author=UBN | access-date=25 June 2024 |location=Kampala, Uganda}} ==See also== * [[Banking in Uganda]] * [[List of banks in Uganda]] * [[FINCA Uganda Limited]] * [[Pride Microfinance Limited]] * [[UGAFODE Microfinance Limited]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * {{usurped|1=[https://web.archive.org/web/20021218100013/http://efcug.com/ Website of EFC Uganda Limited]}} {{Kampala District}} {{coord|00|18|37|N|32|34|37|E|display=title}} [[Category:Banks of Uganda]] [[Category:Companies based in Kampala]] [[Category:Banks established in 2012]] [[Category:2012 establishments in Uganda]] [[Category:2024 disestablishments in Uganda]]
extract: EFC Uganda Limited (EFCUL), also known as EFC Uganda, was  a microfinance deposit-taking institution (MDI) in Uganda whose license was withdrawn and liquidated by Bank of Uganda on 19 January 2024.
